intro: One hundred thirty-eight changes in a single day. Here are ten you'll notice.

1.headline: Share this machine as a GitHub environment
1.say: Share this machine as a GitHub environment, now on by default.

2.headline: Voice Mode can answer how your sessions are going
2.say: Voice Mode can now tell you how your sessions are going.

3.headline: Terminal sign-ins open in front of VS Code
3.say: On Windows, a terminal's sign-in prompt now opens in front.

4.headline: Agent Host moves to Copilot SDK 1.0.26
4.say: Agent Host moves to the newest Copilot SDK.

lines.text: Session export stays with the Copilot extension
Generated images are saved to disk

5.headline: Turn a tool off once: it's off everywhere
5.say: Switch off an MCP server once, and it's off everywhere.

lines.text: MCP servers, plugins and tool sets

6.headline: A new layout for starting a session
6.say: Starting a session gets a new composer, on by default.

7.headline: Agents can organize your Sessions list
7.say: Ask the agent to tidy your Sessions list, and it does.

context.prompt: Pin the Welcome page session and archive the old ones.

8.headline: Voice Mode steers the work in progress
8.say: Speak while the agent works, and Voice Mode steers it.

lines.text: Forms ask one question at a time

9.headline: Computer Use setup, one permission at a time
9.say: Computer Use setup now asks for one permission at a time.

10.headline: MCP allowlists check commands before names
10.say: Your organization's MCP allowlist now checks commands before server names.

params.message: This Model Context Protocol server is not in the list of servers allowed by your organization. A name entry matches, but this allowlist contains command entries, so the server must match an allowed command and arguments. Please contact your administrator for more information.
